description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for querying CPU features across different architectures (ARM, MIPS, x86) in the Starboard API. It includes detailed structures for processor info and feature flags, as well as a function to retrieve CPU capabilities.

methods.name: SbCPUFeaturesGet
methods.description: Retrieves the current CPU features and populates the provided SbCPUFeatures structure.
